application_review: PROGRESS. Previous round rechecked and retained proof hashes preserved.
The product identity uses independent actual subgroup-direction shifts and an auxiliary common direction. Translation invariance eliminates the common direction after finite product factorization.
The expansion is exact, applies to arbitrary finite factor families including the empty family, and does not introduce an approximation or division by a function value.
Unit bounds are required only at nonroot input vertices. The transformed input functions remain unit-bounded by finite product bounds.
The absolute correlation bound has no factor-count loss. The weighted version retains the supplied nonnegative normalized cell probabilities.

Five theorems are individually audited. All factors use the same subgroup and order; no conclusion for products from different subgroups, characteristic-factor localization, or the missing high-order concatenation/Bessel theorem is asserted.
remaining: The common-system master estimates, first-order Bessel, dual energy reduction, recursion and stability are proved. Actual dual functions now have a common finite empirical approximation preserving arbitrary cell probabilities, unit bounds and uniform bounded-test correlations. Exact arbitrary-vertex reflection of the actual subgroup cube law and mixed products is now proved. Mixed cubes now have exact arbitrary-vertex duality and weighted single-vertex replacement estimates. Finite products of dual functions now have quantitative empirical approximation uniform over bounded tests. Exact translated-product expansions and extraction for each fixed test are now proved. The exact mixed face split, projected-face correlation and one-step face Cauchy-Schwarz inequality are now proved. Face energies are now identified with actual copied cube means, with nonnegativity and copy algebra verified. Arbitrary-coordinate permutation invariance, copied-mean nonnegativity and reflection bounds are now established. Full multidimensional mixed Gowers Cauchy-Schwarz, the product-root bound and the single-vertex bound are now proved. Actual dual anti-uniformity, its weighted version and the finite zero-root orthogonality characterization are now proved. Mixed dual recursion, covariance and exact subgroup-shift expansions are now established. Same-subgroup mixed-dual finite products now have an exact averaged dual representation and retain weighted anti-uniformity. Higher-order concatenation controlling dual correlations and the full qualitative Bessel theorem remain missing, as do remaining replica integration, cyclic-to-interval transfer and inverse correlator existence. Coloring-derived targets, Calibration/Alignment and final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction remain. StrongConjecture is unchanged and unproved. No unavoidable blocker is established; publication, PR and prize application remain pending.
